# isVersionCompatible

<link-summary>Checks whether a version is at least the one required.</link-summary>

<web-summary>isVersionCompatible() — Checks whether a version is at least the one required. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/string</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function isVersionCompatible(currentVersion: string, requiredVersion: string): boolean;
```

`versionCompare` decides it, so the comparison is numeric group by group and `1.10` counts as above `1.2`. Both arguments have to be plain dotted numbers; a pre-release suffix is rejected rather than ordered.

## Parameters

| Parameter         | Type     | Description                     |
| :---------------- | :------- | :------------------------------ |
| `currentVersion`  | `string` | The version in hand.            |
| `requiredVersion` | `string` | The minimum that is acceptable. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the current version is the required one or higher.

## Throws

| Exception   | Condition                                      |
| :---------- | :--------------------------------------------- |
| `TypeError` | either argument is not a valid version string. |

## Examples

### Checking a requirement

```javascript
isVersionCompatible("1.3.0", "1.2.0"); // => true
isVersionCompatible("1.2.0", "1.3.0"); // => false
```
